questions.question: What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged? 101 ÷ 48 − 13013 × 13 + 12 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’
are interchanged?
101 ÷ 48 − 13013 × 13 + 12 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 101 ÷ 48 − 13013 × 13 + 12 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 101 × 48 + 13013 ÷ 13 - 12 = ? ⇒ ? = 101 × 48 + 1001 - 12 ⇒ ? = 4848 + 1001 - 12 ⇒ ? = 5849 - 12 = 5837

questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. Statements: Some balls are toys. All circles are balls. All balls are pits. Conclusions: (I) Some circles are toys. (II) All pits are toys.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if
it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the
statements.
Statements:
Some balls are toys.
All circles are balls.
All balls are pits.
 
Conclusions:
(I) Some circles are toys.
(II) All pits are toys.

options.html: Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follow.
Only conclusion (I) follows.

questions.solution:
Conclusions:

(I) Some circles are toys. - False (because there is no direct relation between circles and toys so it can be possible but not definite)

(II) All pits are toys. - False (because All balls are pits and Some balls are toys. So, All pits are toys it is not possible)

questions.question: What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘÷’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged? 4 + 9 × 48 – 6 ÷ 7 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘÷’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘+’ are interchanged?
4 + 9 × 48 – 6 ÷ 7 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 4 + 9 × 48 – 6 ÷ 7 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 4 × 9 + 48 ÷ 6 - 7 = ? ⇒ ? = 4 × 9 + 8 - 7 ⇒ ? = 36 + 8 - 7 ⇒ ? = 44 - 7= 37
